source_evidence: These investments can sometimes offer greater diversification or different returns than more traditional investments such as stocks, bonds, and cash.
answer: Diversification means spreading investments across different types of assets. Many alternative mutual funds do this by including non-traditional assets—such as real estate or commodities—alongside or instead of more traditional investments like stocks, bonds, and cash. This mix can sometimes provide greater diversification or different returns, but it does not guarantee lower risk or better performance. Alternative funds can also involve additional risks and expenses, so their investments and strategies matter.
